name: palette-drift
title: Palette drift
summary: A calm bed of full-strength colour whose hues slowly travel across the structure. A good bottom layer.

name: colour-wash
title: Colour wash
summary: The layer fades through the look's palette, one colour into the next, travelling across it as it goes.

name: wash-breathe
title: Wash breathe
summary: The layer breathes from the low colour up through the body and back, each inhale rising from the ground.

name: plasma
title: Plasma
summary: The demoscene classic: a sum of sine waves wrapped round the structure, through rainbow or cosine palettes.

name: butterfly
title: Butterfly
summary: Psychedelic mirrored wings flow through the palette's body colours, veined with accents.

name: shimmer
title: Shimmer
summary: Every LED glitters fast between the body colour and the highlight, like sequins in a spotlight.

name: rising-sweep
title: Rising sweep
summary: Bands of colour climb every surface like a tide of light, trading a base colour for a sweep colour.

name: depth-wave
title: Playa wave
summary: Colour rolls from the playa front to the back of the nave through a three-colour palette.

name: bars
title: Bars
summary: Bands of palette colour march up, down, across, front to back, or out from the middle, edge to edge.

name: wave
title: Wave
summary: A sine, triangle or square wave rolls across the layer, its line bright, filled below like water.

name: curtain
title: Curtain
summary: A pleated curtain of colour draws open from the middle, holds, and closes again.

name: garlands
title: Garlands
summary: Rows of swags drape across the layer one after another from the top down, then fade away.

name: spire-helix
title: Tower helix
summary: Candy stripes spiral up round each tower and its spire, or round the layer's own centre, like xLights' Spirals.

name: spire-rise
title: Spire rise
summary: Light climbs each spire from its base, crowns the tip in the highlight, then lifts away, tower by tower.

name: ripple
title: Ripple
summary: Drops land at random spots and spread rings across the layer, like rain on a pond.

name: shockwave
title: Shockwave
summary: A ring bursts from the layer's middle in 3D and sweeps through arches, towers and spires as it fades.

name: circles
title: Circles
summary: Glowing balls drift and bounce round the layer, melting together where they meet.

name: pinwheel
title: Pinwheel
summary: Curved vanes of palette colour turn round the layer's centre from a glowing hub.

name: galaxy
title: Galaxy
summary: Spiral arms wheel round a bright core, accent near the heart and body colours at the rim.

name: rose-ripple
title: Rose ripple
summary: Rings of light spread in 3D from the rose window through the arches, towers and spires.

name: rose-chase
title: Rose chase
summary: Petals light in turn round the rose window like clock hands while rings breathe outward.

name: rose-bloom
title: Rose bloom
summary: The rose window opens ring by ring from its heart, holds in full flower, then closes to a bud.

name: meteors
title: Meteors
summary: Shooting stars race along every arch, spire strand and canopy run, trailing fading tails.

name: single-strand
title: Single strand chase
summary: Bands of palette colour chase along every strand: one way, back and forth, or out from the middle.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
summary: Theatre-sign bulbs step along every strand in body and accent groups over the low colour.

name: arch-chase
title: Arch chase
summary: The arches light one after another, front to back, each sweeping up one side and down the other.

name: life
title: Life
summary: A one-dimensional cellular automaton lives along every strand: chaos, triangles or gliders by its rule.

name: aurora
title: Aurora
summary: Slow curtains of green and violet drift over a deep night-blue sky, drawn with fractal noise.

name: clouds
title: Clouds
summary: Soft billows of fractal noise drift across the layer, from deep sky to bright cloud. A good mask input.

name: twinkle
title: Starfield
summary: Every LED a star with its own rhythm, glinting over a slowly shifting night sky.

name: snowflakes
title: Snowflakes
summary: Flakes drift down through the layer, swaying, and settle in a drift that builds, then melts.

name: snowstorm
title: Snowstorm
summary: Driven snow streaks across the layer on the wind, each flake trailing a tail through swirling gusts.

name: canopy-rain
title: Canopy rain
summary: Rain streaks down through the layer and beads along the canopy runs as it passes.

name: lightning
title: Lightning
summary: A forked bolt cracks down from the top and fades over a rolling storm sky, about once every few seconds.

name: fire
title: Fire
summary: Flames lick up from the bottom of whatever the layer lands on, ember red to white-hot.

name: fireworks
title: Fireworks
summary: Shells burst high on the layer into rings of sparks that sag and fade, each in a palette colour.

name: lighthouse
title: Lighthouse
summary: Saturated beams with crisp edges sweep round the layer, leaving a fading afterglow on each face.

name: tendril
title: Tendril
summary: Glowing tendrils wander through the layer in 3D, each trailing a tapering body.

name: heartbeat
title: Heartbeat
summary: A lub-dub swell at a set tempo, spreading outward from the centre of the layer.

name: nave-procession
title: Nave procession
summary: Bands of candlelight walk from the playa front to the back of the nave, a step on every beat.

name: strobe
title: Strobe
summary: Flashes the layer on a steady beat, 2 a second by default. Faster rates can fail the flash check.

name: mirror
title: Mirror
summary: Folds the layer onto itself: left-right, front-back, up-down or along every strand.

name: kaleidoscope
title: Kaleidoscope
summary: Cuts the façade into turning, mirrored wedges round the layer's centre.

name: radial-repeat
title: Radial repeat
summary: Repeats the layer in rings round its centre, zooming outward like a tunnel.

name: mosaic
title: Mosaic
summary: Snaps the layer to blocks: chunky tiles across the façade and runs of LEDs sharing a colour.

name: rotate
title: Rotate
summary: Turns the layer in the façade plane by an angle, or on a steady spin.

name: scroll
title: Scroll
summary: Slides the layer across, up, front to back or along its strands, wrapping round.

name: twist
title: Twist
summary: Swirls the façade like a whirlpool and winds the towers into spirals.

name: tint
title: Palette tint
summary: Recolours the chain from a role of the look's palette, keeping its light and shade.

name: gradient-map
title: Gradient map
summary: Turns light and shade into colour: dark parts take the palette's low colours, bright parts its highlight.

name: hue-shift
title: Hue shift
summary: Turns colours round the wheel by place, across, up, round or along strands: one colour becomes a rainbow.

name: posterize
title: Posterize
summary: Rounds colours to a few flat steps, like a screen print.

name: invert
title: Invert
summary: Swaps light and dark, or turns each colour to its opposite hue.

name: mask
title: Mask
summary: Shows the chain only where its input source is bright: meteors only inside the clouds.

name: threshold
title: Threshold
summary: Lights only what is brighter than a level, turning busy textures into crisp shapes.

name: edge-fade
title: Edge fade
summary: Fades the chain out toward the layer's edges, or from the ground up, so it melts into what is below.

name: sparkle
title: Sparkle
summary: Seeded glints of the highlight flash on top of the chain, LED by LED, like frost catching the light.

name: trails
title: Trails
summary: Leaves a fading afterglow behind whatever moves, like a long exposure.
